object.description: The rickroll: a link that promises one thing and delivers Rick Astley's 1987 video for "Never Gonna Give You Up". It began on 4chan in May 2007 as a twist on an older duck-themed prank, spread through the whole internet within a year, and has never gone away. The video itself was shot in London by Simon West and became, through the prank, one of the most-watched clips on YouTube. Shown here at the size of a 110-inch screen, frozen until you come close.
facts: On 1 April 2008 YouTube rickrolled its own front page: every featured video linked to this one.
Rick Astley himself rickrolled the 2008 Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, popping out of a float mid-song.
The video's YouTube id, dQw4w9WgXcQ, is recognised on sight by enough people that it is a meme in its own right.
The still and the loop are shown under fair use; the video and song remain the property of their owners.
